fonts.display: 'SF Pro Display', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'SF Pro Text', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Pure Canvas
palette.role: Page background, section bands, card surfaces — a near-white that separates structural surfaces from pure white product highlights without introducing tint

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Elevated card surfaces, icon fills, and inverted text on dark/colored backgrounds

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Primary text, headlines, card borders, nav rules — the singular dark anchor; not pure black, a graphite that softens contrast on white

palette.name: Iron Gray
palette.role: Secondary nav borders, list dividers, subdued UI metadata

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Nav borders, link underlines, secondary text in dense lists

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.role: Nav text, button labels on neutral surfaces — slightly cool graphite for UI controls

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Neutral pill button fill, secondary surface tier for compact controls and list rows

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: List row backgrounds, hairline separators in data-dense sections

palette.name: Void
palette.role: Icon fills on light surfaces, nav logo — reserved for the most absolute contrast moments

palette.name: Signal Blue
palette.role: Blue action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

palette.name: Deep Link Blue
palette.role: Inline link text and link underlines throughout body copy — the only chromatic text color permitted in paragraph flow

palette.name: Pulse Green
palette.role: Accent word within hero headlines (e.g. the first verb of a product tagline) — used to color-code an emotional concept inside otherwise monochrome type

palette.name: Deep Green
palette.role: Darker green variant for text-level green accents and underlined links in sustainability/spec contexts

palette.name: Ultraviolet
palette.role: Violet outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges.

palette.name: Ember Orange
palette.role: Orange outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges.

palette.name: Lagoon Teal
palette.role: Teal outline accent for tags, dividers, and focused UI edges.
